g.text: ScaleKitchen OS — Complete Technology Stack & Tools Flow
Frontend • Auth • Clustered Database • Cloud Run Hosting • CI/CD Pipeline • Enterprise Security
• Auto-scales to zero & bursts on traffic
• Single runtime serving SPA + API proxies
• Zero OS maintenance or VM patching
• Edge Caching for JS, CSS, Media Assets
• Hash Routing Fallback for SPA Reloads
• Shift Punch In / Out Attendance Lock
• Manager Remote PIN Reset from Settings
• Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Super Admin, Kitchen Owner, Manager, Rider
• Tenant Boundary Enforcement: Strictly isolates /businesses/{userId} to authenticated owner
• Anti-Tamper Trial Guard: Prevents clients from resetting trialClaimed or extending planExpiryDate
• Whitelisted Driver Permissions: Drivers can only write to GPS, online status, and attendance
• Zero URL Token Exposure: Tokens scrubbed immediately from address bar after parsing
Enterprise compliance and multi-tenant data confidentiality guaranteed.
